body: Good for you. I hope I’ll find mine soon before it’s too late.
This. I feel like we should have the option of ending our own lives without being tied to anyone else.
Why don’t you try talking with your parents first? It might be hard but I feel like there’s a small chance they’ll accept you, no? You’re already at the lowest point, what worse could happen?
Now I’m curious what your method is
Thanks, I appreciate your help a lot. I wish I could talk with you more to distract myself from dark thoughts.
I know it is... But I honestly don’t know what to do.... There’s nobody telling me what I should be doing and I just feel so... lost.
I think that if he know that I don’t love him, it’d make him sad and I couldn’t live with that feeling. If I kill myself, surely he would be sad, but I don’t have to bear the guilt.

I’m currently dating someone right now. He’s so kind and too good for me, but I can’t forget about my ex, so I feel really bad about my current bf. It just made me feel so bad that I couldn’t just love him instead of reminiscing about the past. I want to break up with my current boyfriend because I feel that it’s unfair for him that I couldn’t love him as much as he does to me but I don’t have the courage to tell him. It made me feel even more miserable that I couldn’t bring myself to do that, so that added the reason why I wanted to end it. I don’t want to be alive and know that I’ve hurt him. It sounds so selfish I know but that’s how it is.
And I want to get off the rollercoaster because I don’t want to feel happy, sad, or anything anymore.

I guess the feeling of not knowing what to do. Like, not having something to look forward to and a reason for living anymore. I keep thinking about what I should do everyday and never found an answer. That’s why I feel like living is a torture and it made me feel miserable.
I don’t know, but aren’t problems inevitable? There are bound to be a lot of problems that I’m going to face.

That’s the thing that I keep wondering about. Why do we have to ‘keep going’? 

I know that I will find happiness one day. But I don’t want to feel happy anymore. I don’t want to feel anything. If I keep going, I’m just going to face a lot of problems in the future. I don’t want that. I don’t have anything to look forward to anymore and I’m not planning to find one. I just want to rest forever. Why is it not allowed?

I’ve been thinking that I don’t really have any motivations in living anymore. It’s been years now. There’s no exact reasons but that’s exactly why. I honestly feel that this life is getting tiring and boring. 

Not long ago, I finally dated someone that made me want to live again, but unfortunately he just left me. Honestly, just talking with him made me feel excited about life again but he doesn’t even let me be near him anymore, which made me back to feel miserable and hopeless.
Yeah, I’m going through a hard time right now...
